annotations.title: Get official weather and disaster warnings

description: Official warnings in force from national services in one schema: US National Weather Service, MeteoAlarm (38 European countries), India NDMA (IMD, CWC, state disaster authorities), Brazil INMET, plus worldwide GDACS disasters and USGS earthquakes. Event, hazard type, severity, areas, start and expiry, instructions, issuing service. Most severe first. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/alerts-radar on your Apify account (about $0.002 per alert; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

areas.description: Area names to match: a state, district, county or city, e.g. ["Kerala", "Texas"].

countries.description: ISO codes or names, e.g. ["IN"], ["US", "DE"], or "EU" for every MeteoAlarm country.

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 30, max 500). Cost scales with this.

sent_within_hours.description: Only alerts issued in the last N hours.

states.description: States or provinces by name or ISO 3166-2 code, e.g. ["Kerala", "US-TX"].

name: get_alerts

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

title: Get official weather and disaster warnings
